# Sandwich Hedges

> Friendly, local hedge trimming and overgrown hedge rescue across Sandwich, Deal and the villages of East Kent. Free quotes, fair prices, tidy finish.

## Business

- **Name:** Sandwich Hedges
- **Phone:** 07449 303889
- **Email:** hello@sandwichhedges.co.uk
- **Location:** Sandwich, Kent, CT13, UK
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday

## Areas served

Sandwich, Deal, Worth, Ash, Woodnesborough, Eastry, Sandwich Bay and nearby East Kent villages.
